questions.explanation_en: Chronic pressure before 20 weeks and preeclampsia after 20 weeks along with proteinuria or organ damage. questions.explanation_en: In childbirth, the condition of the mother and the fetus, the progress of the cervix and presentation are decisive. Urgent action is required in umbilical cord prolapse, uterine rupture, severe decollement or fetal distress.
